messages:
Srinivas (VP Product): Quick follow-up from today's all-hands: can leads confirm timelines for API tiering, Console rerun UI, and Optimize recommendations? Any immediate blockers?
Ana (PM): TL;DR: API tiering beta mid-Q3, GA end-Q3; Console rerun UI early-Q4 (infra dependency); Optimize recs prototype now, pilot in Q4.
Ken (Eng): Main blocker for API is quota service migration. Sprint next week; if code reviews stall we could shift GA 3-4 weeks.
Li (DevEx): Please ensure headers remain backward-compatible so SDKs don't break.
Ana (PM): We'll expose legacy headers during beta; SDK teams looped.
Maria (Design): I can run 5 remote usability sessions for rerun flows next week and post notes.
Srinivas (VP Product): Thanks. Optimize privacy question: will any customer tokens be sent in traces?
Ken (Eng): No raw tokens. Hosted/Dedicated send anonymized perf metrics; Private keeps data in-customer. We'll add a privacy blurb to the roadmap doc.
product-docs-bot: Draft uploaded: https://redwood.docs/roadmaps/q3-q4-draft
Ana (PM): Action items: Ken - confirm infra dates by EOD Wed; Maria - schedule tests; Li - draft SDK changelog; I'll update the timeline when infra confirms.
Srinivas (VP Product): If blockers surface, post here and I'll escalate.
